newsitem.title: FRANCE: Research firm downgrades rating on Scor.
newsitem.headline: Research firm downgrades rating on Scor.

text.p: Detroyat switched its rating on reinsurer Scor to negative from positive and cut its 1996 earnings forecasts for the company, a portfolio manager said.
He said Detroyat explained its move by saying the recent sales by Axa and AGF of their stakes in Scor suggested a buyout was unlikely.
The stock, which was down 1.80 francs at 206.90 at 1045 GMT, has risen recently on buyout speculation.
Detroyat cut its profit forecast for the group to 600 million francs from 650 million, saying the first-half results were disappointing and inflated by exceptional items.
